node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 biquadratic source-cover payment
node.statement: For every active bridge-produced diagonal component whose diagonal action does not preserve the quadratic source intermediate field, compile the genus-zero and genus-one biquadratic V4 source-cover passports against every live source-mixing row. Every resulting terminal is empty, transported bijectively to an already paid active image, or assigned an exact distinct-affine-slope payment with bridge multiplicity and chronology. The theorem prints U_source_cover.
node.falsifier: A live source-cover passport or mixing row outside the compiler, a non-bijective transport, an unpaid survivor, or an incorrect owner/slope multiplicity.
